ledger: Man's truck parked outside diner: seen at 00:00 (white semi tractor-trailer facing left) and 01:41 (green Kenworth box truck facing right)

findings.description: The truck parked outside the diner completely changes from a white semi tractor-trailer facing left in the opening shot to a green Kenworth straight box truck facing right when the man exits, with no on-screen event explaining the swap.
